_doc: Panel CHROME colors (tracker §4.16 C) — the header strip a panel's tabs sit on, the tab plate's own fill, tab label/icon, and the vertical-dots edit-mode indicator. Read by ChromePalette.cs as the FALLBACK when no active skin names its own chrome block. CONTRACT: dark = dark plate + light text; light = mid/light plate + dark text. Anything missing here falls back to ChromePalette.ApplyBuiltInDefaults(). 2026-09-06: this file is now a fallback, not the only source — every shipped style (Resources/UiStyles/<Style>.style.json) carries its own modes.<mode>.chrome block, which SkinForge bakes and SkinResolver.ApplyGlobalTheme loads on every theme switch. Edit THIS file to change what a build shows before any theme has loaded, or as a build-wide floor; edit a style's own chrome block to change what THAT skin looks like.
